import re
from datetime import datetime

# Login to Gmail
pw_gmail=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
user_email='chris.mcco@gmail.com'
gmail_tok = apis.gmail.login(username=user_email, password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

# Fetch inbox threads matching spotify (no date restriction)
page_limit=20
page_index=0
all_threads=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(
        access_token=gmail_tok,
        query='spotify',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
        sort_by='-updated_at'
    )
    if not resp:
        break
    all_threads.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_threads_found:', len(all_threads))
print('top_threads:', [(t['email_thread_id'], t.get('subject'), t.get('created_at'), t.get('preview')) for t in all_threads[:10]])

# Only consider threads that look like verification/registration
keywords=['verify','verification','verif','code','account','premium','welcome']
filtered=[]
for t in all_threads:
    s=(t.get('subject','')+' '+t.get('preview','')).lower()
    if any(k in s for k in keywords):
        filtered.append(t)

print('filtered_candidate_threads:', len(filtered))
print('candidate_threads:', [(t['email_thread_id'], t.get('subject'), t.get('preview')) for t in filtered[:10]])

# If none, just take the most recent 5 threads
threads_to_check = filtered if filtered else all_threads[:5]
threads_to_check_ids=[t['email_thread_id'] for t in threads_to_check]
print('threads_to_check_ids:', threads_to_check_ids)

# Pull full thread details for those IDs (limit to 3 for speed)
results=[]
for tid in threads_to_check_ids[:3]:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_tok)
    bodies=[]
    for em in th.get('emails',[]):
        bodies.append(em.get('body',''))
    joined='\n'.join(bodies)
    # Find 6-digit codes
    codes=re.findall(r'\b\d{6}\b', joined)
    results.append({'thread_id':tid,'subject':th.get('label',''), 'codes':codes[:5], 'body_snippet': joined[:200]})

print('thread_code_extraction_results:')
for r in results:
    print(r['thread_id'], 'codes:', r['codes'])
    print('snippet:', r['body_snippet'].replace('\n',' ')[:180])

import re

# Login to Gmail
pw_gmail=[p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]['password']
user_email='chris.mcco@gmail.com'
gmail_tok = apis.gmail.login(username=user_email, password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

thread_id=47825
th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_tok)

# Collect all email bodies
text='\n'.join([em.get('body','') for em in th.get('emails',[])])

print('Thread label:', th.get('label'))
print('Num emails in thread:', len(th.get('emails',[])))
print('Total body length:', len(text))

# Extract verification code patterns: after 'verification code is:' or just alphanum token following it
m=re.search(r"verification code is:\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
code1=m.group(1) if m else None

# Alternative: after 'code is:'
m2=re.search(r"code is:\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
code2=m2.group(1) if m2 else None

# Fallback: find any token that looks like code near the phrase
m3=re.search(r"account verification code\s*[:\-]\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
code3=m3.group(1) if m3 else None

print('extracted_codes:', {'code1':code1,'code2':code2,'code3':code3})

# Print a snippet around the match
for code in [code1,code2,code3]:
    if code:
        idx=text.lower().find(code.lower())
        if idx!=-1:
            start=max(0, idx-80)
            end=min(len(text), idx+80)
            print('snippet:', text[start:end].replace('\n',' ') )
            break
